technical_name: Default printer is a virtual printer (PDF/OneNote/XPS)
possible_causes: Microsoft Print to PDF is default

plain_language.problem: Windows is sending pages to a 'save as file' printer instead of the real printer on your desk.
plain_language.solution: I can show you which printer is currently selected. Changing the default printer in Settings is safer if you do it yourself — I will not silently switch printers.
